messages:
sara: 03:22 UTC - Heads up, customers reporting 500s + weird model outputs from /v1/generate in eu-west. After the config schema migration we see a large fanout to variant 'v-exp'. Paging @jay and @mike on-call.
inc-bot: Pager sent to @jay (primary oncall) — urgency: high — runbook: routing-policy-failures.
jay: Ack — I'm on it, looking at control-plane logs now.
mike: Standing by.
sara: Quick summary: the migration deprecated 'model_variant' and introduced 'variant_alias'. The translation script missed mapping for 'stable' so alias became empty; router treats that as wildcard and routed to latest experimental variant (v-exp). Immediate impact: 4 paying accounts + 2 internal services seeing elevated errors/latency.
anne: Observability: big spike in traffic to v-exp across eu-west and us-east. Latency x3, error rate ~12% in eu-west.
priya: Can we short-circuit the resolver? Is there a host-level override?
jay: Trying admin flag flip now. Running:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route.resolve_aliases":false}'
```
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted — flag update queued on control-plane.
deploy-bot: Flag update applied to control-plane (id: 0x9ab). Rolling to edge gateways.
mike: Edge gateways are picking it up. Error rate dropping on edges in us-east.
anne: eu-west still elevated (~8%). Might be stale KV caches or long-lived connections pinned to v-exp.
sara: Can we pin affected accounts to known-good variant (stable)? Affected: cust-472, cust-889, cust-1302, internal-analytics.
jay: Pinned cust-472, cust-889, internal-analytics via the tenant pin API. cust-1302 uses legacy payload containing 'model_variant' so pin call errors out. I'll add a compat shim.
mike: Autoscaler overshot for v-exp earlier; replicas spun up on node types that caused OOMs. Throttling new replicas now.
inc-bot: Escalation: SRE lead @anne notified.
anne: Setting temporary max replicas for v-exp to 3 to avoid further OOMs.
deploy-bot: Scale limit applied (v-exp max_replicas=3).
priya: Need a short customer-facing note. ETA?
sara: Draft status: "Investigating elevated errors/latency in EU due to routing translation after a schema migration. Mitigations underway: disabling alias resolution and pinning customers to stable variants. We will update in 30 minutes." Sending to ops-commms.
sara: Also proposing rollback of the translation mapping in control-plane to restore previous behavior — less blast radius than full schema rollback.
jay: Plan: revert translation commit in config repo and deploy a canary to us-west only, validate, then roll to global. Starting canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary started: control-plane config reverted v1.5.8->v1.5.7-canary (region: us-west).
mike: Monitoring canary metrics. If stable, proceed with staged roll.
anne: Customer impact update: two customers had ~15% failures, others experienced degraded latency. Logged customer IDs in post-incident doc.
sara: After rollback and pins, tasks?
jay: Post-incident action items: [1] add unit tests for translation mapping, [2] change resolver default to explicit 404 on unset alias (not wildcard), [3] add a canary alert for sudden model fanout (more than 2 variants in 1m), [4] update runbook with quick pin steps.
priya: Also prepare a customer postmortem and credits for the most impacted accounts.
mike: Current status: errors trending down to baseline, throughput stabilizing, OOM risk mitigated by scale cap. I'll remain on call for 60m.
sara: Thanks everyone — I'll collect timeline and start the postmortem draft. Will close pager after 30m of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: Pager resolved — incident marked as mitigated.
